products.name: LA TORRENTE PASSATA DI POMODORO TRADIZIONALE
pros: Uses only Italian tomatoes and citric acid as acidity regulator

trustedSourceSummary: Exact official tests for "passata di pomodoro" were not available in 2025-2026, so the broader official category "passata" was used. No official consumer documents were found in the last 60 days, so the latest available official sources from 2025-2026 were used. Organizations used: Altroconsumo. Both products were evaluated by Altroconsumo in laboratory tests conducted in June 2025, providing recent but older than 60 days evidence of quality and price.
